name: LongCat 2.0
short: Meituan's MIT 1.6T/48B open-weights MoE (1M context) for coding agents; SWE-bench Pro 59.5%, Terminal-Bench 2.1 70.8% self-reported vs 50.19% on AA.
pricingNote: $0.30/$1.20 per 1M in/out, $0.006 cached (OpenRouter); $0.75/$2.95 on SiliconFlow; self-host $0 (MIT)
standout: Meituan's open-weights preview for autonomous coding agents: 1M context at near-flat rates.
tradeoff: Trillion-parameter serving is heavy, and every headline number is vendor-published - AA's Terminal-Bench 2.1 lands 20 points lower.
